toc.label: 2. What you will find on this site

aceptacion.title: 1. Purpose and acceptance
aceptacion.p1: These terms govern the use of this website and of the private areas reached from it: the client area for communities, buildings and companies, and the resident app. The website belongs to the company identified at the end of this document.
aceptacion.p2: What they do not govern is the delivery of the services themselves. Concierge, security, cleaning, gardening, pool and general maintenance services are governed by the contract signed with each community, building or company, and that contract prevails over this text. By browsing the site or using any of its features you accept these terms; if you do not agree, please do not use them.

servicios.title: 2. What you will find on this site
servicios.intro: This site is informational and, for existing clients, a management tool. From here you can:

list.rest: concierge, security, cleaning, gardening, pools and maintenance, and the areas we cover.
the contact form starts a commercial conversation. Sending it does not contract anything or bind either party.
for communities, property managers and companies with a contracted service. It holds incidents, quotes, invoices and service details.
for people living in a community with a contracted service: report an incident, follow its answer and read the noticeboard.
browse published openings and send an application.
general articles about building maintenance and community management. They are guidance only and replace neither a technical report nor professional advice.

servicios.outro: We may change, extend or withdraw any of these sections. That affects the website, never a service already contracted: what has been agreed in a contract is delivered even if the site changes.

cuenta.title: 3. Access to the client area
list1: There is no open sign-up: accounts are created by us for the client, for the property manager they appoint, or by invitation for residents of a community with a contracted service.
The contact details you give us must be accurate and kept up to date: they are how we reach you about an incident or a visit.
Credentials are personal and must not be shared. If several people in the management office need access, request an account for each.
You are responsible for what is done from your account while it is open.
Tell us as soon as you suspect someone has accessed it without your permission, so we can close that session.
cuenta.securityText: We apply security measures that are reasonable and proportionate to the data involved. On your side, use a password unique to this service and sign out on shared devices. The client area itself lets you see open sessions and close them.

uso_aceptable.title: 4. Acceptable use
uso_aceptable.intro: When using this site and the client area, you agree not to do any of the following:
list: Access or try to access information about communities, units or people that is not yours to see.
Use the data shown in the client area —residents, homes, incidents, access logs— for anything other than managing the contracted service.
Extract the site's content in bulk or by automated means without our authorisation.
Interfere with the operation of the site, the app or the systems behind them.
Introduce harmful software or code.
Impersonate another person, community or company, or misrepresent your relationship with them.
uso_aceptable.warning: If this happens we may suspend access immediately to protect everyone else, and report the conduct where it warrants it. The service's contractual relationship is a separate matter and follows its own contract.

propiedad.title: 5. Intellectual property
propiedad.p1: The texts, images, brand, site design and the software behind the client area and the resident app belong to the company or to those who licensed them to us, and are protected by intellectual and industrial property law.
propiedad.p2: What you upload remains yours: the photos of an incident, the documents you attach or the CV in an application. By sending it you authorise us to use it only for what it was sent for —resolving that incident, handling that request or assessing that application— and for the period explained in the privacy policy.
propiedad.sub3: What you may do with our content
propiedad.p3: You may read and print the site's content for personal use or to manage your community. Reproducing, distributing or modifying it for commercial purposes requires our written authorisation.

pagos.title: 6. Contracting and invoicing
list: The price of each service is agreed by contract before we start delivering it, following the fixed quote we prepared for your community, building or business.
What is contracted, its scope and its term are set out in that contract. This website is not where services are contracted and does not replace what was signed.
Invoices for contracted services are available in the client area.
Payment is made as agreed in the contract (transfer, direct debit or another agreed method), not through a payment gateway on this website.
Any claim about an invoice can be raised through the usual contact channels or from the client area.

privacidad.text: Your privacy is important to us. Please review our

garantias.title: 8. Warranties and liability
garantias.intro: What follows refers to this website, not to the services we deliver. Contracted services answer for what their contract and the law require, and nothing in this section limits that:
list: The site's informational content is guidance: it may contain errors or become outdated, and replaces neither a technical report nor professional advice.
We aim to keep the site and the client area available at all times, but we cannot guarantee there will be no interruptions for maintenance or reasons beyond our control.
We are not responsible for the content of third-party sites we link to.
None of the above affects the rights that consumer law grants to anyone holding that status.

terminacion.title: 9. Suspension and end of access
terminacion.p1: We may suspend access to the client area if we detect any of the misuse described above or a risk to data security. Unless urgency prevents it, we give notice first.
terminacion.p2: Access ends when the contractual relationship with the community, building or company ends. From then on, data is kept or deleted as explained in the privacy policy, not as stated in this document.
terminacion.p3: Clauses that by their nature must survive the end of access —liability, intellectual property and governing law— continue to apply.

ley.title: 10. Governing law
ley.p1: These terms are governed by Spanish law.
ley.p2: For any dispute, the parties submit to the courts that have jurisdiction under the law. Where the user is a consumer, the court of their domicile has jurisdiction, as consumer law provides.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.subtitle: Your privacy is our priority. Here you will find all the information about how we collect, use and protect your personal data.

recopilacion.title: 1. Data we collect
recopilacion.intro: We collect information you provide directly when requesting a quote or hiring our services, and data generated by your use of the website.

list1.rest: name, community or company name, email and/or phone number, and the message you send us through the contact form.
if you tick the corresponding box when submitting the form, your consent to receive commercial information about our services.
if you hire a service, your client-area account data (name, email, the community or building managed, and the quotes, invoices and incidents linked to your contract).

list2.rest: pages visited, time spent and actions performed, when you accept analytics cookies.
device type, operating system and browser.
country and region inferred from your IP address, so we know which areas potential clients visit us from.

uso.title: 2. How we use your data
uso.intro: We use the information collected for the following purposes:
list: Respond to your quote request or query, and prepare a service proposal for you.
Provide and manage your contracted service (concierge, cleaning, maintenance, gardening, pools or security) and give you access to the client private area.
Send you commercial communications about our services, only if you gave your express consent when submitting the contact form.
Analyze website usage on an aggregate basis, when you accept analytics cookies, to improve our content and see which areas or services generate the most interest.
Comply with applicable legal obligations, including data protection regulations.
uso.highlight: The processing of your data is based on your consent (contact form, marketing communications, non-essential cookies), the performance of the service contract (clients with a private area), and legitimate interest or legal obligation, as applicable to each purpose.

compartir.title: 3. Sharing information
compartir.intro: We do not sell or rent your personal data. We may share information with:

list.rest: companies that help us run the website and the client area (website hosting, email delivery, analytics measurement), bound by their own confidentiality commitments.

list.strong: Technical staff assigned to your service:
list.rest: if you are a client, the Imora staff (concierge, maintenance, cleaning or other) who need your contact details or your community's details to provide the contracted service.
competent authorities when required by law or to protect rights.

cookies.text: We use cookies and similar technologies. See our

seguridad.title: 5. Security
seguridad.intro: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data:
list: SSL/TLS encryption for all communications with the website and the client area.
Encrypted storage of your client-area password.
Access to your community's or contract's data restricted to the Imora staff who need it to provide your service.

derechos.title: 6. Your rights
derechos.intro: As a user within the scope of GDPR, you have the following rights:

list.rest: request a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
correct inaccurate or incomplete data.
request deletion of your data ('right to be forgotten').
receive your data in a structured, commonly used format.
object to the processing of your data in certain circumstances.

derechos.outro: To exercise any of these rights, email us at
derechos.outroEnd: We will respond within a maximum of 30 days.

retencion.title: 7. Data retention
retencion.p1: We retain your personal data for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this policy, including compliance with legal obligations.
retencion.p2: When your data is no longer needed, we will securely delete or anonymize it.

transferencias.title: 8. International transfers
transferencias.p1: If you accept analytics cookies, the aggregate usage data collected by Google Analytics may be transferred to the United States. Google relies on standard contractual clauses approved by the European Commission as a safeguard for these transfers. Outside this case, we do not transfer your personal data to countries outside the European Economic Area.

contacto.intro: For any queries about this policy or to exercise your rights, contact our privacy officer:

Cookies.title: Cookies Policy
Cookies.subtitle: We use cookies and similar technologies to improve your experience. Here we explain what they are, how we use them and how you can manage them.

que_son.title: 1. What are cookies?
que_son.p1: Cookies are small text files that websites place on your device when you visit them. They are used to make websites work more efficiently.
que_son.p2: Cookies allow the website to remember your actions and preferences so you don't have to re-enter them every time you return.
que_son.highlight: Under European regulations (GDPR and ePrivacy Directive), we need your consent to install non-essential cookies on your device.

tipos.title: 2. Types of cookies we use
tipos.intro: We classify our cookies into the following categories:

items.purpose: Necessary for the basic functioning of the website.
Help us understand how you interact with the site to improve it.
Remember your preferences for a personalized experience.

tabla.title: 3. List of cookies used
tabla.intro: Your choice in the cookie preferences panel is not stored in a cookie, but in your browser's local storage (localStorage), which serves the same purpose but is not sent with every request to the server.

rows.name: _ga_XXXXXX
rows.purpose: Persists session state in Google Analytics.

terceros.title: 4. Third-party cookies
terceros.p1: Some of our partners and service providers may place third-party cookies on your device. These third parties have their own privacy policies.
terceros.p2: We do not control third-party cookies. For more information, please check each third party's privacy policy.

Complaints.title: Complaints channel
Complaints.subtitle: A direct, confidential channel for reporting breaches, irregularities or conduct contrary to regulations related to our activity.

queEs.title: What this channel is
queEs.intro: The complaints channel is Imora's internal route for directly reporting any regulatory breach, irregularity or conduct contrary to professional ethics detected in the course of our activity, in line with Spanish Law 2/2023 protecting whistleblowers.

quienPuedeUsarlo.title: Who can use it
quienPuedeUsarlo.intro: This channel can be used by anyone with a direct relationship with Imora, including:

list.rest: concierges, controllers, technicians and administrative staff.
homeowner communities, buildings and shopping centres that receive our services.
companies and self-employed professionals who work with Imora.
people who have had or will have an employment relationship with Imora.

queComunicar.title: What can be reported
queComunicar.intro: This channel can be used to report matters such as:

list.rest: infringements of employment, safety or environmental law.
workplace, sexual or discriminatory conduct towards anyone.
serious breaches of what was agreed with a community or building.
personal data processing contrary to data protection regulations.
bribery, undeclared conflicts of interest or misuse of company resources.

comoComunicar.title: How to report it
comoComunicar.intro: You can submit your report through our guided assistant, describing the facts in as much detail as possible: what happened, when, who is involved and whether you have any evidence. You can do so with your name and email, so we can confirm we received it, or check that you prefer not to be identified.
comoComunicar.highlight: The identity of the person reporting and of any third party mentioned is treated confidentially throughout the process, with access restricted solely to the staff responsible for handling it.

garantias.title: Guarantees
garantias.intro: Managing this channel is governed by the following guarantees:

list.rest: the reporting person's identity is not disclosed without their express consent.
no form of retaliation is tolerated against anyone reporting in good faith.
receipt of the report is confirmed within a maximum of 7 days.
the investigation and response are resolved within a maximum of 3 months.
personal data processed is limited to what is strictly necessary for the investigation.
